title: Promises to Keep
description: Louis Letrush asks the player to retrieve a horse named Frost from Sibbi Black-Briar, who is jailed in Riften. Sibbi reveals Frost belongs to Maven Black-Briar and offers payment to steal the horse from Black-Briar Lodge along with its lineage papers.

base_facts: I purchased a horse named Frost from Sibbi Black-Briar but the deal was never finalized before Sibbi was arrested.
I want someone to speak with Sibbi in Riften Jail and deliver Frost and the lineage papers to me.
I can be found at the Bee and Barb in Riften.

LISTEN_TO_OFFER: I have asked someone to help me get Frost from Sibbi Black-Briar.
RETURN_TO_LOUIS: This person has returned with Frost and the lineage papers.
QUEST_COMPLETE: I have received Frost and paid for the horse deal, or been persuaded to let them keep the horse.
Quest completes after Louis rewards the player. Player may keep Frost through persuasion or threats.
For your completion conversation with Louis, there are multiple options: Let him go with the horse and receive the leveled gold payment.
It is possible though to receive the payment and then immediately steal the horse; the quest will count as finished without double-crossing Louis.

base_facts: I am locked up in Riften Jail.
I sold a horse named Frost to Louis Letrush but the deal was not finished before I was arrested.
Frost actually belongs to the Black-Briar estate, not me personally.

SPEAK_TO_SIBBI: I have asked someone to steal Frost from Black-Briar Lodge and deliver him to Louis, and I will pay them for it.
The lineage papers are at Black-Briar Lodge.

base_facts: I own the Black-Briar Lodge and all its property, including the horse Frost.
I would not approve of anyone stealing from my estate.

beats.comment: Player hears Louis Letrush's offer about retrieving Frost from Sibbi.
Player speaks to Sibbi in Riften Jail and learns Frost belongs to Maven.
Player steals Frost's lineage papers from Black-Briar Lodge.
Player steals the horse Frost from Black-Briar Lodge stables.
Player returns to Louis Letrush with Frost and the lineage papers for reward.
Quest completes after Louis rewards the player. Player may keep Frost through persuasion or threats.
